applies_to.selection: route stdout; the stream reports no version: the capture discovers it once per run with codex --version (RULE-8) and declares the basis

executor: journal-ocsf-writer CodexStreamMapper (direct Java); one record at a time; no cross-record state

time_policy.reported: none: the exec stream carries no timestamps

family_kind_table.meaning: a tool activity is classified by the item family the stream reports (item.type), never by a tool name; the stream names no tool for web_search or file_change

namespace_kind_bindings.meaning: an MCP tool (item.server, item.tool) takes a kind only from a reviewed binding of that exact server and tool; none is declared, so every MCP tool is 99 other, whatever its name (an MCP tool named exec, Read or web_search never inherits a built-in kind)

rules.owner: item_uid = item.id (identity_basis 2 stream-local; codex.stream.content_item.v1); the model response it belongs to is not reported: no response_uid
item_uid = item.id (identity_basis 2 stream-local); no response_uid: which model response, or invocation, the summary belongs to is not reported
rules.content: one block: block_kind 2 Thought, reasoning_form_id 2 Summary (codex.stream.reasoning_summary.v1: the processor writes the reasoning summary parts joined by newlines; raw reasoning content is not projected)

attribution.outcome: 3 Unattributed: a standalone operation; the stream reports no wrapping call id

rules.status: item.completed: status_id 1/2 from item.status completed/failed (Reported); declined: status_id 99 with status "Declined" (Reported; not a permission decision: none is reported); item.started: 0 Unknown, basis 1 (reported in_progress)
rules.operation: uid = item.id (identity_basis 2 stream-local); command_line = item.command exactly (never parsed into argv); reported_state, exit_code, stdout = aggregated_output

rules.request: tool_name = item.tool, tool_namespace = item.server, tool_family = mcp_tool_call, arguments = item.arguments exactly, reported_state = item.status; kind by codex.stream.mcp_namespace_kind.v1 (no binding: 99 other); a started invocation, not the model request: no response owner, model call id or permission decision follows

rules.result: tool_result.data = item.result.content (null when result has none), structured_result = item.result.structured_content when not null, error_reported = item.status failed; status_id 1/2 from item.status (Reported); item.error stays in data; tool_name, tool_namespace and tool_family as on the start

rules.request: only the declared duplicate form (the id member twice inside the root item object, RFC 6901 /item/id: the exec item id, then the search item own id), recorded at its exact location by a duplicate-recording parse; tool_call_uid = the first id; no tool_name (the stream names no tool), tool_family = web_search, kind 5 search by the family table; arguments = item.action exactly; the record itself is retained verbatim by common.opaque->source_record, both ids in raw_data

rules.result: tool_result.data = item.results when present; arguments = the completed item.action; no tool_name, tool_family = web_search; status_id 0, basis 3 (no status is reported)

rules.request: tool_name = item.tool exactly as the stream labels it (spawn_agent, send_input, wait, close_agent; the emitter labels both ResumeAgent and Wait as wait), tool_family = collab_tool_call, kind 99, reported_state = item.status; sender, receivers, prompt and agent states stay in data (no child-run link is made)

rules.result: no result content is reported; tool_name = item.tool as labelled; status_id 1/2 from item.status (Reported)

rules.request: no tool_name (the stream names no tool), tool_family = file_change, kind 2 edit by the family table, reported_state = item.status; the changes (path, kind) stay in data; an execution observation, not the model request or its arguments

rules.result: no result content is reported; tool_family = file_change, no tool_name; status_id 1/2 from item.status (Reported; the processor reports a declined patch as failed)

rules.usage: usage -> scope 5 Session (the thread) status 2 Final for this run, aggregation 2 Cumulative snapshot (codex.stream.thread_usage.v2, codex.stream.thread_usage_aggregation.v1: ThreadTokenUsage.total, the thread running total at this turn completion; not per turn, never summed with another snapshot); canonical tranches: uncached_input_tokens derived = input_tokens - cached_input_tokens when cache_write_input_tokens is reported 0 (codex.usage.uncached_input.v1: input_tokens includes cached_input_tokens, TokenUsage::non_cached_input; with non-zero cache writes or cached > input the tranche is unavailable, not guessed or clamped; a 0 cache write may be the deserializer default for a provider that reports none), cache_read_tokens = cached_input_tokens, cache_write_tokens = cache_write_input_tokens, output_tokens, reasoning_tokens = reasoning_output_tokens with reasoning_relation 1 Part of output (codex.usage.reasoning_in_output.v1); components[] states each as Reported, Derived or Unavailable with RFC 6901 pointers; measurement_status_id 1 Measured when any component is non-zero, 2 Possibly default when all are zero (codex.stream.usage_measurement.v1: the emitter writes Usage::default() when no update arrived)

rules.session: rule codex.stream.thread_started->session: thread.started.thread_id becomes session_uid on every later event of this source (the stream states its session identity once); the record stays retained whole

rules.selector: any line that is blank, not UTF-8, not one JSON object under strict duplicate-key parsing, or cut off by the end of the source
rules.residual: raw_data (text) or raw_bytes_b64 (bytes); parse_status_id 5 Incomplete at source end when the source ended mid-record

rules.selector: a parsed record whose mapper threw
rules.residual: whole record in data; basis names the exception. A defect of the writer is visible, never a lost record

identity: codex.stream.item_identity.v2: every item.id is the exec processor own stream-local id (item_N, minted per stream; raw app-server ids are dropped), unique only within this artifact of one Journal invocation (journal.run_uid, journal.invocation_index, source_ref.artifact); it is tool_call_uid, operation uid or item_uid with identity_basis_id 2, never the model-facing call id or the provider response id, which the stream omits
